### Overall Assessment

Eleanor Guthrie delivered a sharp, character-driven review that caught all 5 critical issues and most high-severity problems. The review missed the database security group being open, SSH password authentication enabled on the bastion, the EKS public endpoint exposure, S3 encryption, and MySQL version concerns. The persona work was exceptional—maritime trade metaphors ("cargo on an unguarded dock," "treasure maps," "Nassau") integrated seamlessly with technical critique. Remediation code snippets added practical value beyond mere issue identification.
